subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 6: WOW! Culture – Climate change and animals (Project)
outcomes: Read about how climate change puts animals in danger.
Explain why polar bears, giant pandas and Arabian tahrs are in danger.
Plan and present ideas to help an endangered animal.

tf.s: The Arctic sea ice is now 30% smaller than in 1979.
tf.why: Yes, the sea ice is getting smaller.

tf.s: Polar bears are in danger because there is more sea ice.
tf.why: There is less sea ice, and in some areas it melts completely.

tf.s: Bamboo is about 90% of a giant panda’s diet.
Bamboo grows very fast, so pandas always have enough food.
tf.why: Bamboo grows slowly, and climate change might make it grow even slower.

tf.s: Arabian tahrs live in the Hajar Mountains in Oman.
tf.why: Great! The Hajar Mountains are their home.

tf.s: There are more than 10,000 Arabian tahrs in the wild.
tf.why: There are fewer than 2,500 left in the wild.

tf.s: Droughts are a danger for Arabian tahrs.
tf.why: Yes, droughts are a problem for tahrs.

tf.s: An animal that is extinct still lives in many places.
tf.why: Extinct means there are no more of that animal.

tf.s: To help these animals, we must slow down climate change and protect their homes and food.
At a second-hand sale, people sell only brand new things.
tf.why: Second-hand things are things people used before.
